title: SEC proposes broad update to decades-old transfer agent rules with blockchain nod
snippet: The proposal would modernize rules largely unchanged since the 1980s, addressing blockchain-based recordkeeping, tokenized securities and increasingly automated market infrastructure.

title: SEC seeks to update its 1970s-era transfer agent rules for the blockchain age
snippet: The SEC is seeking to update its rules for transfer agents to keep pace with new technology, including blockchain and tokenization.
